text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Is this the price for indulging in the 
taste of decadence every night?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Having your fun sure came at a steep 
price, huh? Serves you right.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Sure, I had some snacks, but I 
should've burned them off with training 
and all that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: You couldn't do it, right? —Even so...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Squishy, aren't they? Pretty 
cute.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
With a squishy lap pillow like that, I'm 
sure one could have the most exquisite 
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to savor that dreamlike bliss 
tonight. Come, shall we head back to our 
room?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so? You might end up with a 
crick in your neck and the most exquisite 
nightmare, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Damn it, what's all this 'lap pillow' 
nonsense? I'll train until I'm rock solid 
so you never mouth off like that 
again...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa threw herself into training 
with reckless abandon and successfully 
brought her weight back to normal.
